name: skills
description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
one_liner: A free collection of ready-made instructions ('skills') that make AI coding assistants work more like a disciplined senior engineer and less like a chatbot.
buyer: An individual developer using Claude Code or a similar tool who wants more consistent, less bloated output — this is a free marketing asset, not itself a paid product.
business_use_cases: A developer installs it to get a repeatable 'grill me on requirements first' workflow before any AI coding task starts.
The repo's creator uses the free skills as a funnel into their paid newsletter and course audience.
A consulting shop adapts the skills into internal standards so every engineer's AI assistant behaves consistently.

money_ideas.idea: The business model already visible in the repo: free skills funnel readers into a paid newsletter and course audience.

steal_this: This repo is itself the weekend project to copy — build your own narrow skill pack for one stack you know well, and use it to build an audience the same way.
